description: This line plot illustrates the number of tokens required for four different types of code generation resources—Tutorials, Library Documentation, StackOverflow posts, and GitHub files—across a range of token counts. The x-axis, labeled “Number of Tokens,” spans from 200 to 800 in increments of 200, representing the input token count. The y-axis, unlabeled but scaled from 10 to 40, represents the number of tokens consumed or required for each resource type. The blue line, representing Tutorials, starts at approximately 23 tokens at 200 tokens and rises to about 29 tokens at 800 tokens. The red line, for Library Documentation, begins at around 27 tokens at 200 tokens and increases to approximately 32 tokens at 800 tokens. The green line, indicating GitHub files, starts at about 28 tokens at 200 tokens, peaks at roughly 32 tokens at 800 tokens, and then slightly declines to around 30 tokens at 1000 tokens. The gold line, for StackOverflow posts, begins at approximately 32 tokens at 200 tokens and steadily decreases to about 12 tokens at 800 tokens.
